_about: Goal pieces and the skills each needs. The app shows how ready you are. Chord progressions only: get the solo and riff themselves from a licensed source.

goals.title: Hotel California (the solo)
goals.note: The solo is built from B minor pentatonic and the B harmonic-minor sound, with bends, slides and vibrato, over the chord progression. Get the notes from a licensed tab book or lesson; here you build every skill it needs.

goals.title: Careless Whisper (the riff)
goals.note: The riff is a fast descending run over a minor-key progression. Get the notes from a licensed source; here you build the speed, accuracy and harmony it needs.
